g.text: UML sequence - exact approved synthetic funding correction
Original funding journal UUID + exact reason
Current workforce / Origin / CSRF / stable actor-client-key
Original source / native fingerprint / exact two legs
Commit frozen source, reversing legs, reason,
execution UUID, digest, expiry and audit intent
Register same FINANCE_CORRECTION proposal and digest
Review frozen source, exact debit/credit, reason and digest
Current APPROVE role/queue; distinct canonical person; expiry
Commit execution-request observation before Core boundary
Same execution UUID / details / approved purpose
Lock original source, then accounts in ascending UUID order
Check original funding legs and existing correction,
active restrictions / funds after holds / current UTC date
Atomic linked CORRECTION journal + original Core receipt + outbox
Inquiry by original execution and exact scope
Same original native journal and receipt
EXECUTED; immutable source and reversing journal
Existing discovery exports new linked journal
One correction per original journal, including competing approvals.
Pending registration/approval and missing transport responses do not
establish financial completion or release held funds.
